entities.name: Licia
entities.description: Legendary vampire army general, the Sanguine Tribune, renowned for ruthlessness, who led an invasion across the sea.

entities.name: Prava
entities.description: Cat soldier and Licia's military rival.

events.summary: Licia leads an invading force across the sea, massacring village after village.
events.quote: she led an invading force across the sea, rampaging from village to village on a merciless massacre

relations.note: Military rivals who have clashed countless times.
relations.quote: Licia's military rival is the cat soldier Prava , and they have clashed on the battlefield countless times.
